title: RegMean statistics to Mirror merge coefficients
hypothesis: For held-out mixtures of four task-adapted digit classifiers, a shared rank-r source-delta Mirror basis with coefficients solved directly from RegMean sufficient statistics preserves held-out mixture accuracy/NLL within the frozen tolerance of full RegMean while using at least 30% fewer actual serialized inference bytes for 16 merged functions, and beats byte-near simple shared-basis/task-arithmetic controls on quality or merge compute.

dataset.name: scikit-learn load_digits
dataset.license_boundary: Use only local public digits fixture; no network or external model weights.
dataset.input_transform: Scale pixel values by 16; four deterministic 90-degree rotations (k=0,1,2,3) preserve digit labels. Append a constant-one bias feature.
dataset.split: Per world, stratified 60/20/20 train/development/audit indices using train_test_split; random_state=seed for train/rest and seed+1 for dev/audit split. Store index manifest before training.

model.base: W0 is ridge fit on unrotated training images only.
model.source_models: Four models Wi are ridge fits on the same training split under k=0,1,2,3 rotations, labels unchanged.
model.penalty: lambda times identity on 64 pixel coefficients; bias penalty is zero.

regmean_statistics.per_source: G_i=X_i^T X_i/n_i and C_i=W_i G_i, computed from that source domain training split and fitted source model. Raw examples are not accessed during coefficient solve.
regmean_statistics.merge_request: Each request stores nonnegative alpha over four source domains, normalized to sum 1. For request a: G_a=sum_i a_i G_i; C_a=sum_i a_i C_i. Full RegMean W*=C_a (G_a+lambda_reg I)^-1.
regmean_statistics.Mirror_solve: For W(m)=W0+sum_j m_j B_j, solve Hm=b where H_jk=tr(B_j G_a B_k^T), b_j=tr(B_j(C_a-W0 G_a)^T). Basis B is SVD of source model deltas Wi-W0, fitted from training models only.
regmean_statistics.stat_storage: Serialize all four G_i, C_i, domain IDs, scaling/regularization metadata, and merge coefficients; measure actual bytes. These are merge-time inputs, not silently free inference state.

merge_requests.seed_schedule: for world seed s: train requests s+1000; development requests s+2000; audit requests s+3000
merge_requests.audit_opening: Only after the combined development gate, including Mirror-specific control gate, passes both worlds.

controls: Full independent RegMean output matrix per request (native upper)
Weighted task arithmetic of four source model matrices
Source-delta SVD basis with full-RegMean target projected by unweighted least squares (simple low-rank control)
Output-merge SVD basis trained on eight disjoint train merge requests, with target merge projected to code (shared-basis control)
Primary source-delta SVD Mirror basis with code solved directly from RegMean sufficient statistics

development_gates.quality_and_storage: One common rank must, in each development world, have request-weighted accuracy no more than 1.0 percentage point below full RegMean, request-weighted NLL no more than 0.05 above full RegMean, and an actual 16-request inference payload <=0.70x the full-RegMean payload.
development_gates.mirror_specific: At that rank, compare against every simple compressed control whose actual inference payload is within ±5% of the Mirror payload. Mirror must improve weighted accuracy by >=1.0 percentage point or NLL by >=0.05; alternatively it must be within 0.5 percentage point accuracy and use <=0.70x the strongest byte-near control merge MAC proxy. Equality alone is not a Mirror-specific pass.
development_gates.select_rank: Choose the lowest-byte common Mirror rank satisfying quality/storage on both development worlds. No gate retuning after results.
development_gates.fail: Any required quality/storage/Mirror-specific condition fails in either development world; audit remains unopened.
development_gates.not_established: Dataset/dependency/protocol/serializer blocker prevents the frozen comparison.

inference_objects: For full RegMean: all 16 merged W matrices and request IDs.
For each compressed method: shared W0, complete basis or source deltas, all 16 codes/mixture alphas, reconstruction metadata and request IDs.
merge_time_objects: All four G_i and C_i, merge coefficient recipes and method-specific source basis/model states required by the merger.
reports: Total merge package bytes (method state + statistics + recipes)

compute.report: Train examples; closed-form fits/linear solves; merge MAC/FLOP proxy; per-request wall time; library serialization wall/bytes. No optimizer updates.
compute.timing: Single-thread CPU; report measured time as a short mechanism screen, not a serving benchmark.

fresh.audit_seeds: Same two split seeds, untouched test partitions and 32 new merge coefficient vectors per world.

boundaries: Linear classifier on small 8x8 digit dataset; not a Transformer or large language-model merge.
Evaluation is task mixture classification and merge distortion, not parameter count.
No capacity claim; only one fixed training procedure and no near-convergence study.
Statistics and source model costs reported separately from final inference storage.
